text:
Kelly Tran: Heads up — got updated pricing sheet from VoltCloud. Contains reserve/spot buckets + commit flexibility. Posting key asks.

Samir Patel: Drop it please.

Kelly Tran: Link (internal): https://files.redwood/volt/pricing-q2.csv — columns they sent:
```
sku,gpu_type,reserved_price_usd,spot_price_usd,reserve_tenor_months,min_commit_units,preemption_profile
```
Will annotate anomalies.

Andre Gomez: Can we get historical spot volatility numbers? Need to model convexity for 1/3/12mo commits.

Maria Chen: VoltCloud said tenors = 3/6/12 months. Early-termination fee applies for <6mo. Spot floor they mentioned = 20% of reserve price.

Samir Patel: Partnerships modelling asks: (1) supply reliability curve by month (2) price ladders per tenor (3) eviction rate time-series — CSV/JSON please. Also need reserved-pool burst SLA details for routing fallback.

Kelly Tran: Asked them for a month-by-month supply schedule (1..12) with per-sku capacity. They sent a PDF with constraints — I'll extract to CSV by EOD. @VendorOpsBot can you ingest to cost-model bucket when I upload?

VendorOpsBot: Ack. Upload job queued: task_id=job-9053. ETA ~45m.

Eric Zhao: For marketplace onboarding — watch marketplace listing fee + revenue-share triggers. If we advertise discounted reserved SKUs it may push us into a different fee band. Should loop in legal/finance.

Maria Chen: @Samir can you ping finance on how to fold listing fees into per-token unit cost? That shifts unit economics.

Samir Patel: Will ping finance. Also VoltCloud flagged a "cap-and-trade" style mitigation: guarantee max eviction rate 8%/month with a 24h rebalance notice. That matters for fallback cost calc.

Andre Gomez: Modeling plan: draft three scenarios — conservative (only reserved), blended (reserve+15% spot), aggressive (reserve+40% spot). Will sample eviction shocks and run MC for routing cost impact.

Kelly Tran: Shared spreadsheet (internal): https://sheets.redwood/supply-models/voltcloud-onboard — please add an "assumptions" tab and tag rows with source. Use input names like `volt_reserved_usd_per_gpu`, `volt_spot_usd_pct_of_reserved`, `volt_eviction_rate_monthly`.

Maria Chen: :thumbsup: I'll add marketplace fee lines and route contract clause #7 (early-termination) to legal for review.

VendorOpsBot: job-9053 started ingestion.

VendorOpsBot: job-9053 completed: artifact s3://redwood-internal/partners/voltcloud/pricing-2056789012.csv 

Samir Patel: Great, next step — ops to simulate routing cost if reserved pool drops 10% vs spot surge. @Andre can you run MC with an eviction distribution (8% mean, heavy tail)?

Andre Gomez: On it. Will run 50k sims and post summary + worst-case percentiles by tomorrow 15:00 PT.

Kelly Tran: Thanks all. If legal/finance sees red flags in contract language, call them out in the sheet and ping me. I'll circle back after Andre's sims.

Eric Zhao: Also flag: note any marketplace terms that force minimum listing price or disclosure; that can affect how we present committed SKUs to customers. :eyes:
